hook.text: Amazon patented 'anticipatory shipping'—sending products before you order them, based on predictive algorithms.

buildup.text: Your purchase history, browsing patterns, and even weather data predict what you'll buy next with surprising accuracy.

discovery.text: Netflix recommendations predict what you'll watch with 80% accuracy. The same AI applied to shopping predicts purchases.

twist.text: Predictive commerce blurs the line between anticipation and manipulation. Did you choose to buy, or were you led to?

climax.text: When algorithms predict your needs before you feel them, free will in shopping becomes a philosophical question.

punchline.text: Predictive Commerce: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What is Amazon's 'anticipatory shipping' patent?
options: Shipping products to nearby hubs before customers even place orders based on predictions
